label: In-situ phase profile
mechanism: env-gated logging-only phase timers inside the live serving loop — control row; the worker's own gate+bench write the breakdown to a persistent log
hypothesis: Ranked-next (1) from the exp-0010 queue note requires a fresh in-situ profile before betting CUDA-graph vs kernel work: every component number we have predates the exp-0007/0008 pooled rewrites (exp-0005's 132,221 launches/step and GPU busy 31-33% were measured on the per-row cores those experiments deleted) or is in-process only (exp-0008-era step ~0.3 s), while the accepted exp-0009 row implies an IN-SITU step of ~0.45 s at conc 64 (cycle 133.4 s/cohort = 64 prefills ~1.18 s + 128 steps — the lockstep model that reproduced exp-0006's 21.5 and exp-0008's 45.3), leaving ~0.15 s/step (~19 s/cohort, ~14% of cycle) of in-situ-vs-in-process gap that no current data can place. This control experiment adds an env-gated, logging-only phase profiler to the live loop (PYENGINE_PHASE_LOG; host perf_counter + dict adds only — no tensor ops, no syncs, no allocations; every phase already ends at a device sync via the fp32 argmax .item(), so host walls are true phase walls; a timestamp between final_logits and the per-row argmax loop splits host-ENQUEUE from exposed-GPU tail; the EngineLoop inbox wait counts engine-thread starvation during cohort refill) so the worker's own D13 gate + timeboxed bench write cumulative 10 s JSON lines to /workspace/logs/insitu_phase_exp0011_2026-07-30.log — a path that persists across the wtrun teardown that deletes serve.log. Falsifiable predictions: (i) prefill_s/prefill_n = 1.1-1.2 s and dec_wall_s/dec_steps = 0.40-0.50 s in situ, confirming the cycle model; (ii) the decode step is still host-side-bound after the pooled rewrites — dec_enq_s >= 60% of dec_wall_s, sync tail < 40% — which grounds CUDA-graph/host-deletion as the next attack; (iii) the ~0.15 s/step gap lands OUTSIDE decode_batch, in (step_s - prefill_s - dec_wall_s) glue plus idle_s bursts at cohort boundaries (HTTP response formatting, detokenize, client turnaround), i.e. serving glue, not kernels. If instead dec_sync_s dominates, CUDA graphs are demoted and the CUDA/CUTLASS native-FP4-MMA port (D5 roadmap, exp-0010 DEADENDS note) is next.
